title: Weekly meal prep: shopping list plus cook order
summary: One calm week of lunches and dinners: shop once, cook in the right order, store what will actually get eaten.

blocks.eyebrow: Sunday prep for a work week
blocks.title: Shop once, cook in sequence
blocks.body: This plan feeds two adults lunch and dinner for five workdays with leftover breakfast options. Quantities are examples — scale for your household.

blocks.heading: Example week menu
rows: Make a pot; freeze two servings if needed
Tacos from chili leftovers + fresh toppings

items.label: 2 lb chicken thighs, 1 lb sausage
items.detail: Or tofu/beans-only if you skip meat — double the chili beans.

items.label: 2 bell peppers, 2 onions, 1 bag carrots, 1 head broccoli
2 cans beans, 1 can tomatoes, chili spices
items.detail: Check pantry spices before buying duplicates.

items.label: Rice or quinoa (enough for 5 lunches)
items.detail: Cook a full pot while the oven works.

items.label: Yogurt, eggs, oats, tortillas, salsa, greens
Olive oil, salt, garlic
items.detail: Only if the kitchen is actually out.

blocks.heading: Cook order (about 2 hours)
items: Heat oven; start rice/quinoa on the stove.
Season chicken and chopped vegetables; get sheet pans in.
While that roasts, start chili on the stove (onions → spices → beans/tomatoes).
Cook sausage in a skillet or on a second pan; slice peppers for Mon/Wed.
Cool, portion lunches, fridge dinners in clear containers, label with day stickers.
Mix oat dry base so weekday mornings are one bowl away.

columns.name: Eat this week
columns.detail: Lunches on the top shelf at eye level. If you cannot see it, you will order takeout.

columns.name: Freeze
columns.detail: Two chili portions max unless you know you will thaw them — frozen soup graves are real.

columns.name: Fresh Friday
columns.detail: Keep tortillas and greens unopened until Friday so taco night still feels like cooking.

items.title: Shop home, wash hands, clear counters
items.detail: Put away non-prep groceries first so the deck is clear.

items.title: Chili simmering, pans out
items.detail: Taste salt now, not on Wednesday.

items.title: Portion and label
items.detail: Future-you is tired. Labels beat memory.

items.title: Done
items.detail: Sink empty enough that Monday does not start with Sunday's pans.

blocks.title: If the week goes sideways
blocks.body: Chili and grain bowls both freeze and reheat. The plan's job is to reduce decisions, not to punish you for a dinner out on Thursday.

blocks.heading: Print the list, then leave the store
blocks.body: The cook order only works if the shopping list was honest. Check the pantry once before you go.
